Results.ReviewText: This grill is luxurious compared to my 30+ year old hand me down grill.  I’m having fun trying new recipes from Weber, too. Here’s to another 30 years of grilling!
Results.Title: New Weber user

Results.ReviewText: Heats up fast, heat controls obey, solid grill, love the gas tank gauge, compact at good height and depth. Fits well on a small porch.
Results.Title: Its small size gives big results

Results.ReviewText: I burned fingers when closing lid because of the position the handle. Make it easier to grab.
Results.Title: Great grill but position of the handle is too far

Results.ReviewText: I have owned a few grills in my time and always thought Weber grills weren't worth the money, boy was I wrong. Build quality is superior to anything its in class. Ease of use. highly recommend!!!!!
Results.Title: The Best Grilling investment I have ever made!!!!!

Results.ReviewText: Have used it three times - very satisfied with the even heating, ease of igniting, and looks of the grill. My only complaint is the difficulty of hanging it on the guage.
Results.Title: Nice grill

Results.ReviewText: Would like a griddle insert for it. What you  got?
Results.Title: Griddle insert

Results.ReviewText: Quality grill. Would have made a couple of design changes...the shelves work well as shelves but aren't made or adequate for pulling the grill and the casters that came supplied are made for much smoother surfaces than my deck. Modified those two items and couldn't be happier.
Results.Title: Happy, however...

Results.ReviewText: Excelente grill and great company when I need their help
Results.Title: First Weber

Results.ReviewText:
I bought it 3 weeks ago. I had some assembling issues but Weber solved them almost instant. As a BBQ I have just admiration how it works. I have for larger tasks another Genius Weber BBQ which definitely exceeded our expectations. This 210 we use for two of us when ee ate in hirry and for smaller jobs.
The ONLY NEGATIVE ASPECT of this 210 are the VERY FLIMSY SIDE TABLES. Definitely nothing that may be slippery can be keft on any of those side tables. Those are NOT HORIZONTAL and BE AWARE of this aspect. We lost a glass container because of it, it was a bit oily and it felt on the flagstone patio with meat in it. The Mounting system is clearly an error from design stage. You can even observe the inclination towards outside of both side tables. This aspect did not make me to give 5 stars because it is in my opinion a 5 star BBQ. Fix the side tables and it will be a 6 stars!
Results.Title: A VERY SIMPLE AND NICE BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Works like a dream and starts instantly. Workmanship is a little on the below par but generally ok. Good for a retired couple.
Results.Title: Great New Compact Grill

Results.ReviewText: Actually it’s a 315 EX. But I love the grill. Once I fire it up I rarely have to go above the lowest setting on the burner controls. And it still gets up to 360. Quality on the build is excellent
Results.Title: 315 EX gets 5 stars

Results.ReviewText: It is the perfect size for our small patio. Easy to assemble, straightforward instructions. It is a GREAT grill.
Results.Title: Spirit E 210 Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: I'd never had a gas grill before but was finding that the time involved with lighting and tending charcoal was making me grill less and less often.  I bought the Spirit II and have used it several times a week for myself or with friends and family over.  It has been easy to use, store (with a cover) and cooks things so fast, I love it!  Will likely grill out on the deck all winter.
Results.Title: Grilling frequently, even for one.

Results.ReviewText: The only issue I have had  is the flame. The knobs don’t seem to lower the flame that much. If you cooking something that’s grease keep an eye on it.
Results.Title: My last spirit lasted many many many years.

Results.ReviewText: I can always trust Weber to produce a great grill.
Results.Title: Trustworthy

Results.ReviewText: Overall a well constructed BBQ. Fit and finish is very good. The controls are smooth and easy to use. Enjoyable to cook with, burner system is very good.
Results.Title: New bbq for me

Results.ReviewText: easy to clean and operate. great size for cooking for 2-4 people. easily collapsible side panels. can’t say enough good things!
Results.Title: Great Beginner's Grill

Results.ReviewText: This is my first Weber.  I am impressed with even heat when grilling. The even heat helps me to complete the grilling of all items at the same time. This smaller grill is perfect for two people but still large enough when company is over.
Results.Title: My First Weber

Results.ReviewText:
Perfect size for 2-6 people.  We had a thermometer on the cover that came not working.  Customer Service quickly Sent a new one. Very easy to
Replace.

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback regarding the Spirit E-210. We are so sorry to hear about your side tables, control panel and flavor bars rusting. This is not what we expect from our products. We are happy to look into this further. Our Care team will be reaching out to follow up. Please look for our outreach soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: Quality is much inferior to precious Weber grills we have owned. Purchased in May 2022 and by August the side tables and front control panel are rusting and the center flavorizing bar is badly peeling. The grill is always covered when not in use and we do not live in a high humidity area. Customer service told me this is normal and would not replace them,  when the store we purchased it from told it was not normal. We will never buy another Weber grill as they do not stand behind their product.
Results.Title: Poor quality

Results.ReviewText: Did my research, I was looking for an American made grill. Went on your web site was excited that that you grill were made in the Chicago area. My wife and I only need a smaller grill, we picked out the Sprit 210. When I got home with my purchase after I had assembled the product I noticed it was imported.I was very disappointed I think your  web site is a bit misleading. I decided to keep the grill even though I could of bought competitors imported product much cheaper. I realize this is a product backed by a great company with good support. It would of received five stars if it was not for my disappointment from you web site. I want to say this is a very quality product but imported.
Results.Title: Imported

Our Care team is here to help. Please look for an email outreach soon!

Results.Title: A Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Weber is a solid company. I’ve owned their charcoal barbecues for over 30 years. When I finally made the change to a gas grill I wanted nothing but a Weber. It’s top of the line and well built. My standards are high. You can easily get a cheap grill at your local big box store or you can invest in a quality appliance through Weber.
Results.Title: Weber is the best

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
